payout_quote: Each contest package includes the 'prize amount' that the creative who you select as a winner gets in exchange for transferring the rights and delivering final files (minus any commission charged to the creative by Hatchwise).
steps: Create a free Hatchwise creative account.
Browse open design and naming contests (logo, web, graphic, slogan, tagline, naming).
Read the creative brief and submit original entries.
Clients review entries and select a winner.
As winner, receive the prize amount (minus Hatchwise's commission to creatives) and deliver final files.
catches: Only winners are paid — most entries earn nothing.
Hatchwise charges a commission to the creative on winnings, so you keep less than the posted prize.
Prize amounts are set per contest by the client; no fixed payout range.
Crowded contests: many creatives enter each contest, so winning is not guaranteed.
Rights transfer to the client on award.
biggest_catch: Only winners are paid, and Hatchwise takes a commission from the creative's prize — the posted prize is not what you receive.
eligibility: Free creative account; designers and writers able to produce original work.
timing: Contests run continuously; winner payment after award and file delivery.
